With the internal reader and touch exploration off, horizontal and vertical swipes perform the menu actions configured in reader setup; keep at least one axis for browsing. World movement keeps its named eight directions and requires the separate fast movement setting. Double tap still selects, hold still reads details, and a two finger tap stops speech. A new swipe mapping must be tested and confirmed within 45 seconds or it returns to the last saved mapping. Swipe distance and maximum duration can also be changed and restored to defaults. Reader controls include a safe eight-direction practice that sends no game actions. Fast movement is off by default; complete the practice or explicitly skip it before enabling. In the world, each fast movement swipe may spend a game turn. Back opens reader controls. With TalkBack, use its usual gestures and the labeled buttons.
Confirm the tested menu swipe mapping within 45 seconds
Restore the previous menu swipe mapping
Menu swipe mapping confirmed and saved.
The menu swipe mapping was restored.
Fast movement is off. Activate to practice all eight directions safely; practice swipes do not move the character.
Fast movement is off. Activate to turn it on; with touch exploration off, world swipes send registered movement actions and may spend game turns.
Fast movement is on. With touch exploration off, an eight-direction world swipe sends one movement action and may spend a game turn. Activate this control to turn it off and resume list browsing.
Skip practice and enable fast movement. With touch exploration off, world swipes can move the character and spend game turns.
Safe swipe practice uses internal reader gestures. TalkBack touch exploration keeps its usual swipes. Choose the clearly labeled skip option only if you want to enable movement without this practice.

Safe movement practice. Swipe in each of the eight directions. The reader will name the direction and count your progress. Practice swipes send no game action and spend no turn. Double tap or press Back to exit at any time; starting practice again resets your progress, so you can rehearse from the beginning.
%1$s. %2$d of 8 directions practiced. No game action was sent.

Practice ended. Your movement setting was not changed.

I heard the sample. Enable the experimental internal reader.

Built-in spoken navigation is active. Swipe left or right to move through the controls, double tap to activate the focused control, swipe up or down to adjust a focused rate or gesture setting, and tap with two fingers to stop speech. The Vietnamese sample must finish before you can enable the internal reader.
Gesture settings. Left handed mode reverses menu browsing only. World swipes always keep their named direction.

Menu swipe mapping. This never changes world movement. Double tap still selects, a long press still reads details, and a two finger tap still stops speech. At least one swipe axis must remain available for browsing.
At least one swipe axis must remain set to browse items.
Test this swipe mapping in the game. Confirm it within 45 seconds or it will be restored.
Turn off TalkBack touch exploration before testing this mapping. No mapping was applied. The labeled Android controls remain available.
The game data could not be installed. Check available storage and try again.

Use the labeled buttons on this screen to continue or exit safely.
Voice selection. Engine, reading language and voice are drafts until a sample spoken with exactly those choices finishes and you confirm. Changing any choice requires a new sample.
The installed voices could not be loaded. The engine default voice remains available for the sample.
The selected voice needs a network connection. It is used only if you allow network voices on this screen; a network voice is never accepted silently.
The engine default voice is used. Whether it needs a network connection is checked when the sample plays, and a network voice is never accepted silently.
The selected voice is no longer installed. Choose another voice or the engine default, then test again.
The saved voice is no longer installed, so the default voice is being used. Open reader setup to choose a new voice.

Speech could not start. A recorded voice message is playing the guidance for this screen. The buttons below are, in order: hear the guidance again; retry the voice; open the Android voice settings; open reader setup; back.
There is not enough free storage to install the game data. Free some space and retry. Your existing game data has not been changed.
Internal reader enabled. This development version does not yet support every game screen. Keep TalkBack available for recovery.
Internal reader disabled. Existing game controls remain selected.

Backup and restore. Export copies your saves and settings into one backup file that you choose. Import only replaces your current data after the chosen file has been checked and you confirm the replacement separately on this screen. Do imports from startup, before a game session starts, so the running game cannot save over restored data.
Export a backup of saves and settings
Import a backup and restore saves and settings

Export, step one of two. Nothing has been exported yet. When you activate the Continue button that is now enabled, the Android file picker opens and the system takes over the screen; this app\'s speech stops while the picker is open. In the picker, choose the folder and file name for the backup. If you pick the name of an existing file there, that chosen file will be replaced. Finishing or cancelling the picker returns you to this screen, and the result is announced here. Exporting never changes your saves or settings.

Import, step one of two. Nothing has been restored yet. When you activate the Continue button that is now enabled, the Android file picker opens and the system takes over the screen; this app\'s speech stops while the picker is open. In the picker, choose the backup file. Returning here, the file is only read and checked against your free storage; your current saves and settings are not replaced until you hear the check result and activate the separate Confirm restore button on this screen.
Continue: open the file picker to save the backup
Continue: open the file picker to choose a backup file
The Android file picker is not available. Nothing was changed; your current saves and settings are unchanged.

Working on the backup. Please wait.

The backup file passed its checks: %1$d files, %2$d bytes. Restoring replaces your current saves, settings and other player data of the kinds inside this backup; kinds that are not in the backup are left alone. Nothing has been replaced yet. Activate Confirm restore to replace them, or Cancel restore to keep your current data.
Confirm restore and replace my current data
Cancel restore and keep my current data

The backup operation failed. Nothing was changed; your current saves and settings are unchanged. Technical code: %1$s
